H01.description: Adds a comment explaining why the fallback page declares a charset; the behaviour change is in H02.

H02.description: The fallback HTML page has no <meta charset> declaration, so browsers may decode the inlined non-ASCII HMR runtime with a legacy encoding and corrupt the inline module script.

I01.description: Adds a new feature (imports keys containing multiple `#`) in resolve.ts; nothing shown ties this to head code of the change.

I02.description: Adds a convertExternalRequire option for ssr webworker builds; nothing shown ties this to head code of the change.

I03.description: Passes isBundled to resolve options for bundled dev; nothing shown ties this to head code of the change.
